releases.notes:
# Changelog: v1.14.1 to v1.15.1

## v1.15.1 - Build fixes for Chukl Render
- Fixed the compile errors in the Water render modules.
- Added replacement helper classes for Water's Freecam (tracer origin) and ProjectionUtil (world-to-screen).
- China Hat now draws through Meteor's renderer (cone, rim, Nimbus ring); it looks similar to Water's but is not identical.
- Storage ESP tracers now use the Meteor-based tracer drawing.
- Hole ESP: removed a leftover reference to a variable that no longer exists.

## v1.15.0 - Chukl Render category and Water modules
- New "Chukl Render" category.
- 19 render modules ported from Water Client (module ids start with "water-"):
  Future Debug, Chunk Finder, Amethyst ESP, Bedrock Void ESP, Block ESP, China Hat, Extra ESP,
  Full Bright, Hole ESP, Jump Circles, Light Debug, Mob ESP, Pearl ESP, Player ESP, Scan Overlay,
  Spawner Notifier, Storage ESP, TNT Explosion Marker, Water Block Notifier.
- Small adapter layer so the Water modules run on Meteor's settings and renderer.
- README updated.

## v1.14.5 - Sus Chunk Finder restored to the v1.14.1 version
- Brought back the v1.14.1 Sus Chunk Finder (smart mode), without the extra sensitivity settings.

## v1.14.4 - Version bump
- Sus Chunk Finder was briefly back at its original pre-smart-mode version.
  (Superseded by v1.14.5.)

## v1.14.3 - Reverts
- Removed the finer sensitivity settings from v1.14.2.
- Removed smart mode as well (restored in v1.14.5).

## v1.14.2 - Finer sensitivity controls (reverted in v1.14.3)
- Sensitivity range raised to 50.
- Added Min Loaded Neighbors, Cover Tolerance and Noise Multiplier.

## v1.14.1 - Sus Chunk Finder smart mode
- Sus chunks that touch (or are one chunk apart) are grouped into zones.
- Noise filter: a lone sus chunk with nothing near it only shows if its heat is at least double your sensitivity.
- Each zone is rated low, medium or high confidence, and higher zones draw brighter.
- Zone marker: a tall outline column at each zone's center.
- Optional chat alert (notify-zones) with the coordinates of new high-confidence zones.

releases.notes:
1.12.0 update
+improved Light Finder (farther and deeper):
Distance: scan-radius now defaults to 12 chunks (up to 32), and block-render-distance to 160 blocks (up to 512).
Block count: max-blocks now defaults to 50,000 (up to 400,000).
Line-of-sight check: it's much larger, and the low thread priority is gone.
Depth: it already scans from the bottom of the world up to max-y (default 0). Raise max-y if you want it to scan higher.

+Improved SusChunkFinder Now has detect the elements within your render distance if you're using amethyst it's only detected around 1-3 sensitivity add Smart detection: the Smart Adjustment toggle now does this job. It only scans and draws chunks inside your render distance, and chunks with more heat draw stronger. Your sensitivity and simulation distance are never changed by it. Turn it off and it scans and draws everything, as Krypton does.
Smaller layer: the new chunk-inset setting shrinks each square by 2 blocks on every side by default. Set it to 0 for the full chunk. I guessed that "smaller" meant the square itself, so tell me if you meant thinner or something else.
